# Frame — Promemoria

## Problem
Owners of small physiotherapy clinics lose paid hours when patients miss appointments without cancelling. [assumption:unvalidated]

## Who
**Primary ICP:** owners of physiotherapy clinics with 2 to 6 therapists in Italy · about 9,000 clinics [estimate:registry-guess] · trigger: a week with three empty slots · signs: a receptionist phoning the day before · reachable via: regional associations

## Today
**Workaround:** the receptionist phones patients the day before [assumption:unvalidated]
**Cost:** unknown [assumption:unvalidated]

## Why now
Since 2026-01-01 the national e-prescription rules require digital appointment records. [assumption:unvalidated]

## Riskiest assumption
Clinic owners lose at least two paid hours a week to no-shows. [assumption:unvalidated]
**Would be falsified by:** five owners whose last month shows fewer than two no-shows a week
**Chosen by:** Mario

## Prior art
Booking systems with SMS reminders exist — adopted by large clinics, not by small ones [assumption:unvalidated]

## Beliefs this frame requires
| Belief | Confidence | Collapse if wrong |
|--------|-----------|-------------------|
| No-shows cost real money | low | yes |

## Open questions
| Question | Who can answer | Inherited by |
|----------|----------------|--------------|
| How many no-shows a week | owners | phase 1 |
